title: Major disaster declared: Wildfires, California (DR-815)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for California (fire), declared 1988-09-29.

title: DANA CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS (6,883 affected)
summary: CYLINDER ROD AND ROD JOINTS ARE WELDED, THESE WELDS ARE SUBJECT TO BRITTLE FATIGUE FRACTURE CAUSED BY RAPID COOLING ALSO THE WELD AREA IS CONTAMINATED BY CHROME PLATING.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (90,000 affected)
summary: WIRING FOR THE POWER LUMBAR SEAT SYSTEM WAS ROUTED DIRECTLY BENEATH THE SEAT CUSHION SPRINGS AND MAY BE ABRADED BY THE SPRINGS.

title: Ford Motor Company: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT (57,400 affected)
summary: SLIDING REAR WINDOW MAY CONTAIN GLAZING PANELS WHICH DO NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 205.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT (11,000 affected)
summary: SEAT TETHER BELTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM (1,250 affected)
summary: RESONATORS USED IN MANUFACTURING OF VIGIL II LIGHTBARS MAY CAUSE UNPREDICTABLE OPERATION.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:SHA (3,000 affected)
summary: BOLTS USED IN THE ATTACHMENTS OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION SYSTEM CONTROL ARMS MAY BE DEFECTIVE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (7,879 affected)
summary: THE SEAT CUSHION MAY INTERFERE WITH THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MECHANISM KEEPING IT FROM LOCKING.

title: FONTAINE MODIFICATION CO.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS (29 affected)
summary: IN ADDING AN AIR TRACTOR PACKAGE TO THE STANDARD AIR OVER HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM A MIX OF PIPE FITTINGS WAS MADE WHICH WERE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE PIPE THREADS ON THE VEHICLES AIR BRAKE SYSTEM.

title: MIDAS INTERNATIONAL CORP.: EXHAUST SYSTEM:MUFFLER:RESONATOR (156 affected)
summary: HEAT SHIELD WAS INSTALLED ON LOWER SIDE OF MUFFLER INSTEAD OF THE UPPER SIDE.

title: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (30,204 affected)
summary: INCORRECT CURE PROCEDURE DURING MANUFACTURING PROCESS.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: LPG LINES (112 affected)
summary: LEAK IN LP GAS SERVICE LINE CAUSED BY LINE CONTACTING REAR SUSPENSION SYSTEM WHICH RESULTS IN LINE RUPTURE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR (129 affected)
summary: THE UNDERSIZED WELD ON THE REAR SUSPENSION BRACKETRY ATTACHMENT CAN CAUSE BRACKET FAILURE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: WHEELS:OTHER (19 affected)
summary: FASTENERS THAT HOLD THE REAR WHEEL TO THE HUB AND DRUM ASSEMBLY MAY BE IMPROPERLY TORQUED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV (75,000 affected)
summary: WINDSHIELD FRAME METAL MAY CRACK AT THE WIPER ARM PIVOT MOUNTINGS DUE TO METAL STRESS DURING WIPER OPERATION.
